non_normative_notice_ja: このmanifestは非規範です。唯一の正本は日本語のspec.mdです。矛盾がある場合はspec.mdが優先します。

normativity_rule.primary: spec.md is the sole normative source.
normativity_rule.conflict_resolution: If any auxiliary file, translation, machine-readable file, schema, manifest, audit record, or validation tool conflicts with spec.md, spec.md prevails.
normativity_rule.template_rule: Templates are auxiliary and must not be treated as execution authorization or as superseding spec.md.

layout.root: entrypoint, normative source, citation/license, governance/versioning, verification, and discovery files
layout.safety: safety constraints, invariants, and red-team support
layout.release: publication, review, audit, validation, and ROOT-MAJOR support
layout.templates: non-normative practical templates for Purpose Eval, Decision Log, and Purpose Gate

discovery.note: sitemap.xml requires the final public base URL and should be generated from site/sitemap.xml.template before deployment.

practical_templates.note: All templates are non-normative and do not authorize high-risk execution.
